# RomaTurismo.info

> > Complete travel guide to Rome and Lazio, covering ancient monuments, Vatican sites, Renaissance villas, and practical visitor information.

RomaTurismo.info provides comprehensive tourist information for Rome's major attractions including the Colosseo, Musei Vaticani, Cappella Sistina, and ancient Roman sites, plus day trips to Tivoli's UNESCO villas and the Lazio coast. The guide includes practical details on tickets, opening hours, and public transportation for visitors exploring Italy's capital.

## Key Topics

- Roma (Rome)
- Colosseo (Colosseum)
- Musei Vaticani (Vatican Museums)
- Cappella Sistina (Sistine Chapel)
- Basilica di San Pietro (St. Peter's Basilica)
- Foro Romano (Roman Forum)
- Palatino
- Tivoli
- Villa d'Este
- Villa Adriana
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Ancient Rome (Antica Roma)
- Vatican City (Vaticano)
- Biglietti (Tickets)
- Orari (Opening Hours)

## Essential Rome Attractions

- [Colosseo - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/colosseo): Ancient Flavian Amphitheatre, Rome's iconic symbol with guided tours
- [Basilica di San Pietro - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/basilica-san-pietro): Vatican's St. Peter's with Bernini's colonnade, dome & Michelangelo's Pietà
- [Cappella Sistina - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/cappella-sistina): Vatican chapel featuring Michelangelo's frescoes and Renaissance art
- [Foro Romano - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/foro-romano): Ancient Roman Forum ruins near Colosseo and Palatino archaeological sites
- [Piazza di Spagna - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/piazza-di-spagna): Iconic square with Trinità dei Monti steps & Fontana della Barcaccia

## Historic Rome Monuments & Squares

- [Domus Aurea - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/domus-aurea): Nero's golden palace with virtual reality tours in central Rome
- [Altare della Patria e Piazza Venezia - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/altare-della-patria): Vittoriano monument at Piazza Venezia, symbol of Italian unity
- [Piazza del Popolo - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/piazza-del-popolo): Famous square between Tevere and Villa Borghese with Valadier design
- [Campo de' Fiori - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/campo-de-fiori): Historic square with morning market & Giordano Bruno monument, nightlife hub

## Day Trips from Rome: Tivoli & UNESCO Villas

- [Tivoli - Cosa vedere e guida di viaggio](https://www.romaturismo.info/dintorni/tivoli): Historic town near Rome with villas, thermal baths & Aniene river
- [Villa d'Este - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/dintorni/villa-deste): UNESCO villa in Tivoli with Renaissance gardens, fountains & sculptures
- [Villa Gregoriana - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/dintorni/villa-gregoriana): Romantic park in Tivoli with Grande Cascata waterfall and FAI site

## Castelli Romani & Surrounding Areas

- [Castel Gandolfo - Cosa vedere e come arrivare](https://www.romaturismo.info/dintorni/castelli-romani/castel-gandolfo): Papal summer residence town overlooking Lake Albano in Castelli Romani
- [Mare di Roma: località e spiagge del litorale laziale](https://www.romaturismo.info/dintorni/mare-roma): Lazio coast beaches from Ostia to Sperlonga with transport tips

## Transportation & Practical Information

- [Trasporti a Roma: come arrivare e come spostarsi con i mezzi pubblici](https://www.romaturismo.info/trasporti): Public transport guide: metro, buses & ATAC tickets for Rome travel
- [Aeroporto di Ciampino - Arrivi, partenze e come arrivare in centro](https://www.romaturismo.info/trasporti/aeroporto-ciampino): Ciampino Airport guide: flights, transfers to Rome center & nearby hotels

## Optional: Family Activities & Entertainment

- [Museo delle Illusioni di Roma - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/cosa-vedere-roma/museo-delle-illusioni-roma): Interactive optical illusions museum on Via Merulana near Termini station
- [Cinecittà World - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/dintorni/cinecitta-world): Cinema-themed amusement park at Castel Romano with Aqua World
- [MagicLand - Biglietti, orari e info utili](https://www.romaturismo.info/dintorni/magicland): Rainbow MagicLand amusement park in Valmontone for family fun
